outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram showing single calculated percentage values (illumination overhead) per exposure-time condition, not an average of replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B is a line plot (photobleaching decay curves with shaded s.e.m.), which is exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a scatter plot of ΔROS vs exposure time with error bars; scatter plots already show individual points and are exempt.
Panel D shows individual migration tracks for each cell (line plot of raw trajectories), not an averaged summary statistic, so individual data point overlay is not applicable.
Panel E is a bar chart of mean±s.e.m. migration speed, and individual cell data points are overlaid as dots on each bar.
Panel F consists of fluorescence micrographs, not a quantitative plot.
Panel G consists of time-lapse micrographs, not a quantitative plot.
Panel H consists of time-lapse micrographs, not a quantitative plot.
Panel I is a line plot of mean±s.e.m. cell area over time; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlay.
Panel J is a line plot of mean±s.e.m. mitochondrial area over time; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlay.
